worldcombat.skill.grassknot.summary: Call the grass and roots out of the ground and let the target's own weight take it down: the heavier it is, the harder it falls. A patch of turf opens under the target and closes a moment later, snaring whoever is still standing in it; step out and you escape. The binding form snares wider and longer but closes more slowly.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.use.0: Let a heavy target trip over its own weight
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.use.1: Leave a patch of turf that denies a piece of ground
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.use.2: Reach in and slow a heavy, fast or hard-hitting foe
Opens a %2$s block snare under the target and deals about %1$s special damage to everyone inside when it closes; heavier targets take more.
There are %1$s seconds between the turf opening and the vines closing, so stepping out dodges it; the opened turf stays in the world for about %2$s seconds.

A snared target cannot move for about %1$s (though it can still act) and carries a slow for about %2$s (movement speed 70%% lower); it loses %3$s Speed stages (Pokemon drop Speed stages, other combatants lose movement speed), and that stage drop does not come back when the snare expires.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.knot.on: Binding form: a wider and longer snare with a heavier trip, at the cost of a longer delay, slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.knot.off: Quick-trip form: a small, fast snare with more power and a quicker cast, but a shorter hold.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.timing: Sow within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.growth.0: At level %1$s, the snare power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.growth.1: At level %1$s, the snare power rises to %2$s and the snare radius to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.preference.k: On: a wider and longer snare with a heavier trip, but a longer delay (easier to step out of), slightly less power and a longer recovery and cooldown. Off: a small, fast snare with more power and a quicker cast.
worldcombat.skill.grassknot.preference.a: Only sow once a foe is within this distance. Larger values let it open with a trip from further away; smaller ones keep it close.
It will not open with Grass Knot against a target lighter than this many kg; 0 means always. Raise it to save the move for heavy foes.
